; Generated by ps2vk-shaderc from tess_quad.tese. Do not edit.
;
; VU1 registers:
;   VF01 viewport scale, VF02 viewport offset, VF03 color scale
;   VF10.. shader inputs, VF20 gl_Position, VF21 color output
;   VF19 texture coordinate output (S, T, Q, or U, V)
;   VF25-VF26 the previous two screen positions (culling)
;   VF05-VF09, VF18-VF19, VF27-VF31 push constants, uniforms, constants and temporaries
;   VI02 vertices left, VI03 input pointer, VI04 output base, VI05 output pointer
;   VI06 index pointer, VI07 qwords per vertex, VI08 scratch, VI09 index list offset
;   (0 = in order), VI10 first vertex, VI11 vertices to the next triangle, VI12 vertices
;   per triangle (0 = no culling), VI13 scratch, VI14 instances left, VI15 instance pointer

		.vu
		.align 4
		.global	tess_quad_tese_CodeStart
		.global	tess_quad_tese_Convert
		.global	tess_quad_tese_CodeEnd
tess_quad_tese_CodeStart:
; prologue: constants and the batch header
         NOP                                      lq            VF01,0(VI00)
         NOP                                      lq            VF02,1(VI00)
         NOP                                      lq            VF03,2(VI00)
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI01,VI00,80               ; input base
         NOP                                      lq            VF04,0(VI01)               ; GIF tag for each instance
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI13,2(VI01)               ; qword offset of the first vertex
         NOP                                      ilw.y         VI09,1(VI01)               ; index list offset, 0 = vertices in order
         NOP                                      iadd          VI10,VI01,VI13             ; first vertex
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI07,3(VI01)               ; qwords per vertex
         NOP                                      ilw.z         VI14,2(VI01)               ; instances
         NOP                                      ilw.w         VI15,2(VI01)               ; qword offset of the first instance
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI04,VI00,512              ; output base
         sub.xyzw      VF23,VF00,VF00             iadd          VI15,VI01,VI15             ; XYZ2 w = 0 (ADC off); instance pointer
         NOP                                      iadd          VI05,VI04,VI00             ; output pointer
         NOP                                      ilw.z         VI12,3(VI00)               ; vertices per triangle, 0 = no culling
; constants
         sub.xyzw      VF05,VF00,VF00             NOP                                      ; float constant
         NOP                                      loi           0x40c90fdb                 ; 6.28318548
         addi.x        VF05,VF05,I                NOP
tess_quad_tese_instance:
; each instance restarts the primitive with a GIF tag of its own
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI14,VI14,1                ; instances after this one
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI08,0(VI01)               ; NLOOP with EOP
         NOP                                      sq            VF04,0(VI05)               ; the instance's GIF tag
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI08,VI08,0x4000
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI14,VI00,tess_quad_tese_eop ; the last instance keeps EOP
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI08,VI08,0x4000           ; delay slot: EOP off
         NOP                                      isw.x         VI08,0(VI05)               ; more instances follow
tess_quad_tese_eop:
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI05,VI05,1
         NOP                                      lq            VF24,2(VI01)               ; y = winding sign of the first triangle
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI02,1(VI01)               ; vertices per instance
         NOP                                      iadd          VI03,VI10,VI00             ; first vertex
         NOP                                      iadd          VI06,VI01,VI09             ; index pointer
         addy.z        VF24,VF00,VF24             iaddiu        VI11,VI00,3                ; the third vertex completes the first triangle
         NOP                                      sq.z          VF24,1(VI01)               ; the current triangle's sign
tess_quad_tese_loop:
; indexed batch: the list holds each vertex's qword offset from the first
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI09,VI00,tess_quad_tese_fetch ; vertices in order: VI03 already points at the next one
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         NOP                                      ilw.x         VI08,0(VI06)               ; index
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI06,VI06,1
         NOP                                      iadd          VI03,VI10,VI08             ; vertex it refers to
tess_quad_tese_fetch:
; load inputs (location order; the pipeline repoints each at its binding's stream)
         NOP                                      lq            VF10,0(VI03)               ; location 0
; input conversion: the pipeline patches each input's 4 pairs for its attribute format
tess_quad_tese_Convert:
         NOP                                      b             tess_quad_tese_body        ; retargeted past the inputs that need nothing
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         itof0.xyzw    VF10,VF10                  loi           0x3f800000                 ; integers to floats; I = UNORM/SNORM scale
         muli.xyzw     VF10,VF10,I                loi           0xbf800000                 ; scale; I = SNORM clamp
         maxi.xyzw     VF10,VF10,I                NOP                                      ; clamp to -1
         mul.xyzw      VF10,VF00,VF00             NOP                                      ; components the format lacks: 0, w = 1
tess_quad_tese_body:
; shader body
         NOP                                      lq            VF06,768(VI00)             ; line 22: tessellation input read
         subx.w        VF07,VF00,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 22: OpFSub (subtraction)
         mulw.xyzw     VF06,VF06,VF07w            NOP                                      ; line 22: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         NOP                                      lq            VF07,776(VI00)             ; line 22: tessellation input read
         mulx.xyzw     VF07,VF07,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 22: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         add.xyzw      VF06,VF06,VF07             NOP                                      ; line 22: OpFAdd (addition)
         NOP                                      lq            VF07,792(VI00)             ; line 23: tessellation input read
         subx.w        VF08,VF00,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 23: OpFSub (subtraction)
         mulw.xyzw     VF07,VF07,VF08w            NOP                                      ; line 23: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         NOP                                      lq            VF08,784(VI00)             ; line 23: tessellation input read
         mulx.xyzw     VF08,VF08,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 23: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         add.xyzw      VF07,VF07,VF08             NOP                                      ; line 23: OpFAdd (addition)
         suby.w        VF08,VF00,VF10y            NOP                                      ; line 24: OpFSub (subtraction)
         mulw.xyzw     VF06,VF06,VF08w            NOP                                      ; line 24: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         muly.xyzw     VF07,VF07,VF10y            NOP                                      ; line 24: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         add.xyzw      VF06,VF06,VF07             NOP                                      ; line 24: OpFAdd (addition)
         mulx.x        VF07,VF10,VF05x            NOP                                      ; line 26: OpFMul (multiplication)
         mulaw.x       ACC,VF07,VF00w             NOP                                      ; line 26: sin()
         NOP                                      loi           0x40490fdb                 ; 3.14159274
         addi.x        VF08,VF07,I                NOP
         NOP                                      loi           0x3e22f983                 ; 0.159154937
         muli.x        VF08,VF08,I                NOP
         NOP                                      loi           0x4b400000                 ; 12582912
         addi.x        VF08,VF08,I                NOP
         subi.x        VF08,VF08,I                NOP
         NOP                                      loi           0x40c90fdb                 ; 6.28318548
         msubi.x       VF08,VF08,I                NOP
         NOP                                      esin          P,VF08x
         NOP                                      waitp
         NOP                                      mfp.x         VF08,P
         NOP                                      lq            VF07,8(VI00)               ; push constants, bytes 64..79
         mulx.x        VF07,VF08,VF07x            NOP                                      ; line 26: OpFMul (multiplication)
         addx.y        VF07,VF06,VF07x            NOP                                      ; line 26: OpFAdd (addition)
         NOP                                      move.xzw      VF08,VF06                  ; line 26: OpCompositeInsert (a component write)
         NOP                                      move.y        VF08,VF07
         NOP                                      lq            VF06,769(VI00)             ; line 27: tessellation input read
         subx.w        VF07,VF00,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 27: OpFSub (subtraction)
         mulw.xyzw     VF06,VF06,VF07w            NOP                                      ; line 27: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         NOP                                      lq            VF07,777(VI00)             ; line 27: tessellation input read
         mulx.xyzw     VF07,VF07,VF10x            NOP                                      ; line 27: OpVectorTimesScalar (vector * scalar)
         add.xyzw      VF06,VF06,VF07             NOP                                      ; line 27: OpFAdd (addition)
         NOP                                      lq            VF07,739(VI00)             ; line 27: tessellation input read
         mul.xyzw      VF06,VF06,VF07             NOP                                      ; line 27: OpFMul (multiplication)
         NOP                                      lq            VF07,4(VI00)               ; push constants, bytes 0..15
         NOP                                      lq            VF09,5(VI00)               ; push constants, bytes 16..31
         NOP                                      lq            VF11,6(VI00)               ; push constants, bytes 32..47
         NOP                                      lq            VF12,7(VI00)               ; push constants, bytes 48..63
         mulax.xyzw    ACC,VF07,VF08x             NOP                                      ; line 30: OpMatrixTimesVector (matrix * vector)
         madday.xyzw   ACC,VF09,VF08y             NOP
         maddaz.xyzw   ACC,VF11,VF08z             NOP
         maddw.xyzw    VF07,VF12,VF08w            NOP
         NOP                                      move.xyzw     VF20,VF07                  ; gl_Position
         NOP                                      move.xyzw     VF21,VF06                  ; color output, location 0
         NOP                                      move.xy       VF19,VF10                  ; texture coordinate output, location 1
         sub.w         VF22,VF00,VF00             NOP
         maxy.w        VF22,VF22,VF10y            NOP                                      ; fog output, location 2, not below 0
; epilogue: perspective divide, viewport, GS formats, store
         NOP                                      ilw.w         VI13,1(VI01)               ; 1 = UV in texels (PRIM.FST)
         NOP                                      div           Q,VF00w,VF20w              ; Q = 1 / w
         NOP                                      waitq
         mulq.xyz      VF22,VF20,Q                NOP
         NOP                                      ibne          VI13,VI00,tess_quad_tese_uv
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         mulq.xy       VF19,VF19,Q                NOP                                      ; S / w, T / w
         NOP                                      b             tess_quad_tese_st
         addq.z        VF19,VF00,Q                NOP                                      ; delay slot: Q = 1 / w
tess_quad_tese_uv:
         ftoi4.xy      VF19,VF19                  NOP                                      ; U, V to 12.4 fixed point
tess_quad_tese_st:
         mul.xyz       VF22,VF22,VF01             NOP                                      ; viewport scale
         add.xyz       VF22,VF22,VF02             NOP                                      ; viewport offset
         ftoi4.xy      VF23,VF22                  NOP                                      ; x, y to 12.4 fixed point
         ftoi0.z       VF23,VF22                  NOP                                      ; z to integer depth
         mul.xyzw      VF24,VF21,VF03             NOP                                      ; color 0..1 to GS range
         ftoi0.xyzw    VF24,VF24                  NOP
         miniw.w       VF22,VF22,VF00w            NOP                                      ; fog not above 1
         mulx.w        VF22,VF22,VF03x            NOP                                      ; fog 0..1 to 0..255
         ftoi4.w       VF22,VF22                  NOP                                      ; the FOG register's F field starts at bit 4 of w
         NOP                                      sq            VF19,0(VI05)               ; ST (and Q), or UV
         NOP                                      sq            VF24,1(VI05)               ; RGBAQ
         NOP                                      sq            VF22,2(VI05)               ; FOG
; culling: test the triangle this vertex completes
         sub.w         VF23,VF00,VF00             isubiu        VI11,VI11,1                ; ADC off; one vertex closer to a triangle
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI12,VI00,tess_quad_tese_xyz ; no culling
         NOP                                      ilw.y         VI08,3(VI00)               ; delay slot: 1 for a fan
         NOP                                      ibne          VI11,VI00,tess_quad_tese_shift ; triangle not complete yet
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         sub.xy        VF20,VF26,VF25             iadd          VI11,VI12,VI00             ; P1 - P0; vertices to the next triangle
         sub.xy        VF21,VF22,VF25             lq            VF24,1(VI01)               ; P2 - P0; batch header, z = winding sign
         opmula.xyz    ACC,VF20,VF21              NOP
         opmsub.xyz    VF20,VF21,VF20             NOP                                      ; z = signed area
         mul.z         VF20,VF20,VF24             lq            VF21,3(VI00)               ; area * sign, negative = cull; cull context
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI13,VI00,0x20             ; MAC flags land 4 cycles later; z negative flag
         NOP                                      NOP
         NOP                                      NOP
         NOP                                      NOP
         mulx.z        VF24,VF24,VF21             fmand         VI13,VI13                  ; next triangle's sign; sign flag of z
         NOP                                      sq            VF24,1(VI01)
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI13,VI00,tess_quad_tese_shift ; front facing: draw
         NOP                                      ilw.w         VI13,3(VI00)               ; delay slot: ADC bit
         NOP                                      NOP
         NOP                                      mfir.w        VF23,VI13                  ; ADC on: the GS keeps the vertex but draws nothing
tess_quad_tese_shift:
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI13,VI11,2                ; 0 at the batch's first vertex
         NOP                                      ibeq          VI08,VI00,tess_quad_tese_p0 ; not a fan: P0 <- P1
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         NOP                                      ibne          VI13,VI00,tess_quad_tese_p1 ; a fan's P0 stays its hub
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
         NOP                                      move.xy       VF25,VF22                  ; the hub
         NOP                                      b             tess_quad_tese_p1
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
tess_quad_tese_p0:
         NOP                                      move.xy       VF25,VF26
tess_quad_tese_p1:
         NOP                                      move.xy       VF26,VF22                  ; P1 <- this vertex
tess_quad_tese_xyz:
         NOP                                      sq            VF23,3(VI05)               ; XYZ2 (draws unless ADC is set)
         NOP                                      iaddiu        VI05,VI05,4
         NOP                                      iadd          VI03,VI03,VI07             ; next vertex
         NOP                                      isubiu        VI02,VI02,1
         NOP                                      ilw.y         VI08,3(VI01)               ; qwords per instance
         NOP                                      ibne          VI02,VI00,tess_quad_tese_loop
         NOP                                      lq            VF24,3(VI01)               ; delay slot: z = gl_InstanceIndex
         NOP                                      iadd          VI15,VI15,VI08             ; next instance
         addw.z        VF24,VF24,VF00             NOP                                      ; gl_InstanceIndex + 1
         NOP                                      sq.z          VF24,3(VI01)
         NOP                                      ibne          VI14,VI00,tess_quad_tese_instance
         NOP                                      NOP                                      ; branch delay slot
; send the batch to the GS and stop
         NOP                                      xgkick        VI04
         NOP[E]                                   NOP
         NOP                                      NOP
		.align 4
tess_quad_tese_CodeEnd:
